questions.question: Rupert purchase a second-hand TV for Rs. 4,600, spends some money on its repairs, and then sells it for Rs. 5,406, thereby earning a profit of 6%. How much did Rupert spend on the repairs?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Purchase price of TV = Rs. 4,600

Selling price of TV = Rs. 5,406

Profit percentage = 6%

**Formula used:**

Profit = Selling Price (SP) - Cost Price (CP)

Profit% = (Profit/CP) × 100

CP = Purchase price + Repair Cost

**Calculation:**

⇒ Profit = (Profit% × CP) / 100

⇒ 5,406 - CP = (6 × CP) / 100

⇒ 540,600 = 6 × CP + 100 × CP

⇒ 540,600 = 106 × CP

⇒ CP = 540,600 / 106

⇒ CP = 5,100

⇒ CP = Purchase price + Repair Cost

⇒ 5,100 = 4,600 + Repair Cost

⇒ Repair Cost = 5,100 - 4,600

⇒ Repair Cost = Rs. 500

**Thus, Rupert spent Rs. 500 on the repairs.**

questions.solution:

Four cows are tethered to the four corners of a square field of length 28 m

Each cow can just touch the two cows in the adjacent corners

The grass in the area inside the square field that was accessible to the cows was enough to fee them for 22 days

⇒ (28)² - 4 × π × (14)² × (90°/360°)

⇒ 784 - 4 × π × 196 × (1/4)

⇒ 784 - (22/7) × 196

**∴ It is enough to feed for 6 days.**

questions.question: A, B and C can complete a task in 36, 54 and 72 days respectively. Together they started the task but A left 8 days before the completion of the task while B left 12 days before the completion. The number of days for which C worked is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A, B, and C can complete a work in 36, 54, and 72 days respectively.

A, B, and C started the task together,

A left 8 days before the completion of the work.

B left 12 days before the completion of the work.

**Formula used:**

Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

The efficiency of A = (1)/(36)

The efficiency of B = (1)/(54)

The efficiency of C = (1)/(72)

Suppose work is completed in d days.

Work done by A = ((d - 8))/(36)

Work done by B = ((d-12))/(54)

Work done by C = (d)/(72)

Total work done by A, B and C = ((d - 8))/(36) + ((d - 12))/(54) + (d)/(72)

⇒ ((6d - 48 + 4d - 48 + 3d))/(216) = 1

⇒ 13d = 216 + 96 

⇒ d = (312)/(13) = 24 days

**∴ The number of days for which C worked is 24.**
